resources.string: Turn on automatic tracking, then connect one source: payment-app alerts or bank SMS.
Tracking is on, but no payment source is connected yet. Connect payment-app alerts or bank SMS. Manual entry remains available in Today.
A payment source is connected. Allow notifications so you can see new Auto entries and use Undo or Keep.
A payment source is connected and notifications are allowed. Automatic tracking is ready.
Connect one source first. Notifications let you see and undo an Auto entry. A Live Update on the lock screen or status bar is optional.
The original message text is never stored or sent. Only the amount, shop name, time and a local payment reference used to catch duplicates are kept.
Connect at least one source. Android may restrict access to payment-app alerts or bank SMS on some phones. You can still add purchases by hand from Today.
Live Update on lock screen and status bar
Optional · Not allowed or not supported
A shop with a rule always gets that category. Without a rule the app uses what you chose last time for that shop, then its built-in list, and otherwise saves it as Other and asks you.

Added on its own: card payments, and payments to a shop you have a rule for, have logged before, or that is on the built-in list.

Asked first: payments to a new name or to a person, cash withdrawals, alerts with no shop name, and anything of ₹20,000 or more.

Never added: money received, refunds, failed payments, one-time passwords, bills that are due and offers.

A purchase added on its own can be undone for 10 minutes. Your circle sees it only after that, or sooner if you tap Keep.
